title: incident.v1
description: One line of STATE/ops/incidents.jsonl (append-only). An `opened` line is written when a run stops or is refused (challenge, cooldown, politeness, egress, approval, unreachable, incomplete) or stalls; an `acked` line, naming the same id, records who looked and what they did. An incident is OPEN until an acked line for its id exists. Files are truth: agents are told by doorbell lines (the monitor) and hooks, never by this file being edited.

code.description: The CLI exit code (5-10, 12 unreachable, 13 incomplete), or null for a stall.

stage.description: The command (stage or utility) that stopped.

note.description: acked only: what was done or decided.
